context:
Goal: a change that fails review after every round you allowed stops instead of looping.
Problem (rule): when you grant a fourth review round and that round fails, nothing says what happens next.
Based on (read): rule roles-review-cap-three: "A held change is parked. It gets no fix lane and no more work until the owner decides."
Departs from: main — a failed granted round leaves the change open, so a fix lane starts without you; option a parks it for you.
home: step review-fix-check-round (fix checks name their round)

lastAnswer.note: as long as its flagged to me and doesn't go to sleep idling quietlky

options.gain: No change loops past the rounds you granted without your word.
options.how: Held means parked: no fix lane starts and nobody works on it until you pick drop, restart or merge, as after round 3.
options.label: Hold it (Recommended)

options.how: Open means a fix lane starts at once without asking you, and review goes on to a fifth round.
options.label: Keep it open
options.lose: A change can keep looping past every round you granted.

reply: Closed 15:47 CST: you picked a, on your condition: a held change is put in front of you on this page at once, never left parked in silence. The lane is told to build it that way.
short: Failed granted round: hold or not
title: Hold a change whose extra review round, granted by you, fails
why: No ruling covers a failed round you granted beyond three.
